pages.title: Instant Trees
pages.text: $(item)Apple$(), $(item)Cherry$(), and $(item)Peach Tree Seeds$() raise a full fruit tree on grass or dirt the moment they're planted — OreSpawn horticulture has never believed in waiting.$(p)Craft tree seeds from the fruit itself, and the orchard pays its own way forever.

pages.title: What Falls From Above
pages.text: Fruit leaves ripen on their own time and drop their bounty below: cherries and peaches from their trees, and from apple leaves — usually apples, rarely $(item)golden$() ones, and once in a very long while something $(item)enchanted$() or stranger.$(p)Plant a row, walk away, come back to a cookbook's worth of fillings.
